Alejandra Reyes: hey team :wave: I'm taking over the 23:00->07:00 shift. quick perms check before I go primary — do I have PD escalation to SRE-oncall and grafana edit for the infra dashboards?
Sam O'Neill: you have PD as primary for the 'redwood-prod' escalation policy, but not the grafana edit role yet. I granted a view link earlier.
Alejandra Reyes: copy. any gaps on AWS? I need to assume the emergency role for runbook steps.
Mike Chen: Alejandra, you don't have the temp assume-role for aws-prod-emergency. I'll grant a 4h JIT now. sending the ARN.
Mike Chen: (granting) ✅ done. Run this to assume: 
```
aws sts assume-role --role-arn arn:aws:iam::111222333444:role/aws-prod-emergency --role-session-name oncall-Alejandra --duration-seconds 14400
```
Natalie Park: +1 on the grafana. I've requested a temporary 'Editor' role for you via the admin console. Should finish in ~2min.
Alejandra Reyes: thanks. PD check: can someone confirm I can escalate to infra-sre-1 and infra-sre-2? don't want to be blocked if paging.
Sam O'Neill: infra-sre-1 is on rotation and reachable. infra-sre-2 is OOO until 03:00 UTC. escalation policy will try infra-sre-1 then infra-sre-2 then platform-leads. you're good but expect a delay to infra-sre-2.
incident-bot: ALERT suppression? There is an ongoing flurry on service/storage-latency. If you escalate, note the incident ID #6712.
Alejandra Reyes: got it. I'll triage #6712 if it pages. Any runbook pointers?
Mike Chen: runbook link: https://redwood.runbooks/infra/6712 - short version: check redis cluster, check placement groups, then fallback to degraded config. Use 'kubectl -n infra logs -l app=redis' and `redis-cli --cluster info` if you need deep checks.
Alejandra Reyes: copying commands into my notes. Grafana: which dashboard should I watch for the first 15 minutes?
Natalie Park: watch DB/Redis -> latency & miss-rate, and the 'global request queue length' panel. I pasted a direct panel link into the handoff channel.
Sam O'Neill: minor note: if you need to open a cross-team bridge, use #incident-bridge and tag @pagerduty. We try to avoid @here unless critical.
Alejandra Reyes: understoood. quick perms sanity: PD escalate works, aws assume-role works, grafana editor pending (~1min). any objections to giving me temporary Grafana edit?
ops-sre-bot: ACTION LOG: grafana-role-request by Natalie Park -> approved. TTL 4h.
Alejandra Reyes: grafana editor is live, I can annotate and silence alerts. creating annotations for the shift start.
Alejandra Reyes: annotation: "Ale handoff - primary - verified PD/AWS/Grafana access" :memo:
Sam O'Neill: perfect. small coverage gap FYI: APAC fallback primary is in a different rota; if something pages at 02:30 local APAC, ping @sam directly.
Alejandra Reyes: noted. final sanity: pagerduty link?
Sam O'Neill: https://redwood.pagerduty.com/incidents - filter by service=redwood-prod. Use 'Escalate' -> pick infra-sre-1 if needed.
Alejandra Reyes: all set. I'll monitor dashboards and respond to any pages. tagging the secondary: @Mike Chen you're my secondary for the night. can you be reachable?
Mike Chen: I'm on call as secondary. phone with me. if you need me to assume in >4h I can request extension.
Alejandra Reyes: thanks. closing handoff: primary=Alejandra, secondary=Mike, pd escalation checked, aws assume-role confirmed, grafana editor granted, runbook link posted, incident bot ID noted (#6712).
incident-bot: HANDOFF_COMPLETE by Alejandra Reyes — metadata: {"primary":"Alejandra Reyes","secondary":"Mike Chen","pd_checked":"true","aws_role":"aws-prod-emergency","grafana":"editor","runbook":"/infra/6712"} 
Alejandra Reyes: headed to start. ping me if anything pops. :thumbsup:
